messages.subject: Width result contract will preserve unavailable coverage
messages.body: Planned width evidence records requested value, setter applied flag, observed buffer/window value and any limitation in an owned JSON sidecar while keeping exact stdout/stderr unchanged. If RawUI width is unavailable in CreateNoWindow redirected processes, byte/control assertions can pass but actual distinct-width coverage will remain Blocked and fullControlSuiteAccepted=false (separate contract-control count retained), rather than fabricating width acceptance. Current f05 still frozen and running; no implementation edits until it settles.
